card.name: The letter w inside names
card.fires_on: The letter w (or 'ww', 'wd', 'uw') appearing partway through a rare proper name or foreign-origin word, such as Lauwerys, 'auwai, Nourwanda, or powwows.

modes.label: w inside surnames and names
modes.description: A lone w splits a rare personal or place name into pieces.

modes.label: w in powwow and foreign terms
modes.description: A w or ww inside a Native American, Hawaiian or Arabic term.

card.plain: It fires on a stray letter w in the middle of an unusual name or foreign word.
